_comment: Read denies exist to keep compiled output out of an agent's context. Two
reasons qualify a page: it has a source twin (a sibling .md, or
tools/make-docs-pages.py — edit the .md, regenerate, never the .html),
or it is a very large hand-authored page whose bytes are not worth a
context window. Hand-authored pages that are neither — start.html,
index.html, tutorial/index.html, and the small stubs — stay readable:
they have no .md to read instead, so denying them made them uneditable
in practice. Keep this list in sync with PAGES in tools/make-docs-pages.py.
